releaseNotes:
v0.2.11

- Settings → About now shows the real build version (BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME
  + VERSION_CODE), matching the format already used in the update dialog.
  Was hardcoded as "버전 1.0" / "Version 1.0" regardless of build.

This bump also gives a device on 0.2.10 an available update to download, so
you can verify the v0.2.10 update-UX fixes (instant feedback on 지금 설치 +
no idle-close mid-download) in the wild.
